meta_description: Every OpenDrone project with its current status, what the community voted to build next, and the financial goals the shop is working toward.
title: What we're building.
lead: The end goal is to cover every corner of the FPV hardware spectrum, foundational hardware first: stack, receiver, frame, motors, video. This page is the live state of that plan: where every project stands, what you voted for next, and what the money is building toward.
s1_body: Everything starts as a conversation on [the OpenDrone Discord](@discord): what the market needs, which specs make sense, what can realistically be produced. Agreeing before anyone draws is the point. It stops two people building the same thing, and it kills bad ideas before someone spends weeks on a layout. When you want to do more than talk, [the contributing page](/contributing) is the manual.
s2_body: The same board we work from. Each product carries exactly one status flag, explained below. The flag is the status: the same value is set as a status-* topic on the product's GitHub repo, and nothing describes status in prose anywhere else.
status_launched_legend: In the shop and settled. The design has stopped moving; buy it and it will not change under you.
status_beta_legend: Launched, first production batch. You can buy it in the shop, early-batch pricing can be lower, and the design can still get updates between batches.
status_alpha_legend: Coming soon. Community testers and firmware maintainers fly the hardware before anyone can buy it. Where a product page exists, you can join the waitlist there.
status_in-progress_legend: A first design exists and prototypes may already be ordered, but nothing is under test yet.
status_planned_legend: No design yet, on purpose. We name it early so the community can step in and help design the hardware they are interested in contributing to.
votes_body: Every order carries an optional ballot: in the cart, rank up to three of the planned and in-progress projects from this board, and checkout files your ranking with the order. The counts are re-tallied from orders weekly and published right here, on the cards above and in the standings below. The vote steers our prioritisation; engineering reality can still overrule it, in the open.
votes_empty: No ballots counted yet. When you order, the cart carries a ranked ballot for what we should build next; the standings appear here and on the board above.
votes_method: Ranked choice: 3 points for a first pick, 2 for a second, 1 for a third.
goals_body: Shop profit goes to R&D and manufacturing, and we would rather show that than say it. So here is what we are saving for, one goal at a time. The meter is computed from sales on a weekly rhythm, in coarse 5% steps: deliberately approximate, never a live feed of our books.
goals_foot: Goals are ours, not earmarks. No order is tied to a machine, and nothing here is crowdfunding; it is just where the margin goes.
